suggestedOps.title: Suggested ops

@suggestedOps.title.description: Title of the dialog listing the file operations Ask Cmdr has suggested, and the matching View-menu item.

suggestedOps.description: Ask Cmdr suggested these. Nothing runs until you approve it.

@suggestedOps.description.description: Line under the dialog title. Makes clear that opening the dialog changes nothing by itself.

suggestedOps.empty: Nothing is waiting for you right now.

@suggestedOps.empty.description: Shown in the dialog body when the agent has no pending suggestions.

suggestedOps.loadFailed: Cmdr couldn't read the suggestions. Close this and open it again.

@suggestedOps.loadFailed.description: Shown when reading the suggestion list threw. Distinct from the empty state, which would read as the agent having suggested nothing.

@suggestedOps.agentReason.description: Label above the agent own words for a group. Load-bearing: it marks the text as the agent claim rather than as something Cmdr verified.

@suggestedOps.cmdrFacts.description: Label above the deterministic file facts shown beside the agent reason, so a claim can be checked against something the agent could not invent.

@suggestedOps.fileCount.description: How many files a suggestion group covers.

@suggestedOps.approve.description: Button that queues one group operations.

@suggestedOps.reject.description: Button that turns one group down.

suggestedOps.approveCount: Approve {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

@suggestedOps.approveCount.description: Approve button when the user turned some rows off, so the count says what would actually run.

@suggestedOps.review.description: Button that expands a group to show the files it would touch.

@suggestedOps.collapse.description: Button that collapses an expanded group file list.

@suggestedOps.reversibleRestoreMove.description: Marker on a group whose files can be put back where they were (move, trash, rename).

suggestedOps.reversibleDeleteWritten: Undo by deleting what it writes

@suggestedOps.reversibleDeleteWritten.description: Marker on a group that only adds files (copy, extract, a new archive), so undoing means removing what it created.

@suggestedOps.irreversible.description: Marker on a permanent delete, or a compress that overwrites an existing archive. Disclosure only: Cmdr never refuses the group over it.

@suggestedOps.folderWillBeCreated.description: Marker on a group whose target folder does not exist yet.

suggestedOps.folderWillBeCreatedTooltip: The target folder is not there yet. Approving creates it, exactly as it would if you started the move yourself.
suggestedOps.destinationUnknown: Cmdr couldn't check the target folder

@suggestedOps.destinationUnknown.description: Shown when the destination volume did not answer in time, so whether the folder exists is genuinely unknown rather than assumed.

@suggestedOps.fromPattern.description: Marker on a group a selector produced, so the user knows the list was matched rather than named one by one.

suggestedOps.changedUnderReview: Ask Cmdr changed this suggestion while you were reading it.

@suggestedOps.changedUnderReview.description: Notice shown when the agent amended the open group. The rows on screen stay put until the user asks for the new version.

@suggestedOps.showNewVersion.description: Button that reloads a group the agent changed while the user was reading it.

@suggestedOps.columnFile.description: Column heading for the file each proposed operation would touch.

@suggestedOps.columnNewName.description: Column heading for the name a rename would give the file.

@suggestedOps.columnSize.description: Column heading for the size Cmdr index held when the suggestion was made. Says when suggested because relaying it as current would be a claim nothing can back.

@suggestedOps.columnChanged.description: Column heading for the modification date Cmdr index held when the suggestion was made.

@suggestedOps.noIndexData.description: Shown instead of a size or date when Cmdr index held nothing for a file. Never a zero, which would read as an empty file.

@suggestedOps.includeFile.description: Accessible label for the per-file checkbox in a suggestion group.

@suggestedOps.loadingFiles.description: Placeholder while a window of the file list is being read.
